name: Uniform collapse (cylindrical)
blurb: Gas (gamma = 5/3) falling toward the axis of an axisymmetric (R, z) run at a speed proportional to R, u = -R, so that all of it would reach the axis at t = 1. It stays uniform, with no shock: its density grows as (1 - t)^-2. The cells next to the open faces are held at the exact solution: an open face alone cannot push gas in as the collapse does, and a rarefaction would run in from it at the sound speed.
